ValidationRule.description: Venkat: Created as part of NZC Implementation Purpose: Check if valid state code is populated if country entered as US
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( CONTAINS( Country__c , "US"), OR( ISBLANK( State__c ), LEN(State__c) <> 2, NOT(CONTAINS( $Label.NZC_US_Country_State_Codes,State__c)), CONTAINS (State__c,';') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the valid 2 character State Code if Country entered is US
